title: paper_draft
description: The writer's draft of the paper under C8 and a venue's guidelines (Implementation Decisions 13): the whole manuscript in Markdown, every claim sentence ending with provenance tags copied from the evidence the prompt gave, each figure a placeholder line `{figure:<figure_id>}` that code replaces with the figure the figure role verified, and the figures asked for. Code writes research/paper/ from it, runs the linter and the seven checks, and returns any failure to the same session with the list.

markdown.description: the manuscript: `# <title>` first, one `## ` heading per section the venue asks for, figure placeholders on lines of their own, and the references section in the venue's citation form

figures.description: the figures the draft places, each drawn by the figure role from manifested results at the venue's target; the empty list for a draft with none

figure_id.description: the placeholder's id, which also names figures/<figure_id>/

claim.description: the one sentence the figure has to carry, as the draft says it

claim_type.description: comparison, trend, distribution, and so on

data.description: the result artifacts the figure draws, as paths in research/manifest.json

evidence.description: the provenance tags the claim rests on

notes.description: what the owner should know on reading the draft: a guideline the draft cannot meet by itself, a claim left out and why; the empty string when there is nothing
